objective.stem: The leader of my class in school is the ___
The leader of a street or community is called the ___
The leader of a state is the ___
We need leaders so that people will be ___
objective.answer: guided, with order kept and work finished
distractors: left alone, with nothing at all to say
paid money on every market day

objective.stem: The leaders of my home are ___
A duty of a parent is to give food, clothes, education, love and ___
When father and mother are away, the smaller children are led by ___
Respect at home begins with small things: answering "yes ma/sir", carrying a bag and ___
A community is people living together in ___
objective.answer: one area — a street, a village or a town
distractors: one house with many storeys only
one class in the school building
one market stall on a table

objective.stem: The name of the place I live is said like this: ___
An example of community mobilization is ___
objective.answer: the clean-up exercise on the last Saturday of the month
distractors: the long sleep taken in the afternoon sun
the heavy rain that falls in the month of June
the closing of the market at high noon

objective.stem: The leaders who meet to plan for the people include the chief, the imam, the pastor and the ___
objective.answer: chairman of the local government area
distractors: driver of the bus at the park
pupil of the school near the market

objective.stem: When a neighbour's house falls down, the community brings ___
A strong community gives its people ___
A child's part in the community includes ___
objective.answer: not littering and keeping the gutters free
distractors: throwing papers on the wide road
blocking the gutter with soft mud
frightening the old people at the gate

objective.stem: A responsibility is a thing we ___
objective.answer: must do, and not a thing we may choose to do
distractors: may forget when we are very busy
can buy for ourselves at the market
give to another child in the class

objective.stem: If I lose or spoil a borrowed book, the consequence is that ___
objective.answer: it must be replaced or paid for

objective.stem: Respect for elders is shown by greeting them, listening, obeying and ___
objective.answer: using their respectful title, such as ma or sir
distractors: calling them by a nick name at the gate
answering them back with a loud voice

objective.stem: Polite words we use are please, thank you, sorry and ___
Nigeria's neighbours include Benin Republic, Niger, Chad and ___
The capital of Nigeria is ___
The white on the Nigerian flag stands for ___
Nigeria became independent on the ___
The flag is flown at half a mast when ___
The national pledge is said at school to ___
objective.answer: be faithful to the country and to honour Nigeria
distractors: greet the visitors that come to the school
sing before the match on Friday
open the market for the traders

objective.stem: The Y on the shield stands for ___
Our money is the Naira; its small part is the ___
objective.answer: kobo, and one hundred kobo make a Naira
distractors: pesewa, and ten pesewa make a cedi
sen, and one hundred sen make a naira
bit, and one thousand bits make a naira

objective.stem: A sacred place like the church or the mosque must be met with ___
distractors: food and drink in the hall

objective.stem: Objects we respect include the flag, religious books, the elders' belongings and ___
Writing my name on a monument is wrong because it ___
objective.answer: damages a thing that belongs to the whole country
distractors: will cost me some of my money for the paint
takes a very long time in the afternoon
makes the old wall look very colourful

subobjective.stem: Mention four leaders of the community and where each leads.
State four qualities of a good leader.
points: goes first in what is right

subobjective.stem: Give four duties of a parent in the home.
Name the four things that make up the community around me.
Mention four community activities that need mobilization.
points: building a bridge or a borehole

subobjective.stem: State four responsibilities of a pupil at school.
Give three ways we respect elders and three ways we respect younger ones.
points: do not push them, help them when they fall, no bullying

subobjective.stem: Name the colours of the flag and the meaning of each.
Mention four things that identify Nigeria as my country.
State four objects or places that must be respected.

theory.stem: Who is a leader? Give four reasons why we need leaders
Describe the work of a good leader at home and in the class
What is community mobilization? Give two examples and the children's part
Describe the Nigerian flag and the coat of arms, saying what the colours and the Y stand for
Write on respect: name three people, three places and three objects we must respect, and say how
